cards.ex: It's easier to absorb information when you're genuinely interested in the subject.
cards.exUz: Mavzuga chin dildan qiziqsangiz, ma'lumotni o'zlashtirish osonroq.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni tushunib, eslab qolish jarayoni.

cards.ex: She's been excelling academically ever since she changed her study habits.
cards.exUz: U o'qish odatlarini o'zgartirgandan beri o'qishda a'lo bo'lib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'qishda yuqori natijalarga erishish.

cards.ex: His educational journey took him from a small village school to a prestigious university.
cards.exUz: Uning ta'lim safari uni kichik qishloq maktabidan nufuzli universitetga olib bordi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim olish jarayoni davomida boshdan kechirilgan tajribalar.

cards.ex: Many students struggle with complex mathematical concepts.
cards.exUz: Ko'p talabalar murakkab matematik tushunchalarni tushunishda qiynaladilar.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum tushunchalarni tushunishda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: Professor Lee is a well-respected authority in the field of linguistics.
cards.exUz: Professor Li tilshunoslik sohasida hurmatli mutaxassis.
cards.uzDef: So'ziga ishonch va hurmat bilan qaraladigan bilimdon shaxs.

cards.ex: Her intellectual curiosity led her to explore many different subjects.
cards.exUz: Uning aqliy qiziqishi uni turli xil mavzularni o'rganishga undadi.
cards.uzDef: Bilim olishga kuchli istak va qiziqish.

cards.ex: It's important to apply knowledge learned in the classroom to real-world situations.
cards.exUz: Sinfda o'rgangan bilimlarni real hayotiy vaziyatlarga qo'llash muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'rgangan bilimni amalda ishlatish.

cards.ex: Practice problems help to cement understanding of the material.
cards.exUz: Amaliy mashqlar materialni tushunishni mustahkamlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Tushunchani yanada chuqurlashtirish va mustahkamlash.

cards.ex: The academic rigor of the program prepared her well for her future career.
cards.exUz: Dasturning akademik qat'iyligi uni kelajakdagi faoliyatiga yaxshi tayyorladi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'limning yuqori talablari va qiyinligi.

cards.ex: The report provides an in-depth analysis of the economic impact of the new policy.
cards.exUz: Hisobotda yangi siyosatning iqtisodiy ta'siri chuqur tahlil qilingan.
cards.uzDef: Mavzuni har tomonlama va batafsil o'rganish.

cards.ex: She plans to pursue studies in medicine after graduating from high school.
cards.exUz: U o'rta maktabni tugatgandan so'ng tibbiyot sohasida o'qishni davom ettirmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim olishni davom ettirish, odatda universitetda.

cards.ex: Developing critical thinking skills is essential for success in today's world.
cards.exUz: Tanqidiy fikrlash qobiliyatini rivojlantirish bugungi kunda muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni tahlil qilish va baholash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The course will build upon the knowledge you already have.
cards.exUz: Kurs sizda allaqachon mavjud bo'lgan bilimga asoslanib rivojlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bilim yoki ko'nikmalarga qo'shimcha bilim kiritish.

cards.ex: Before committing to a full degree, he decided to test the waters with a few online courses.
cards.exUz: To'liq darajaga majburiyat olmasdan oldin, u bir nechta onlayn kurslar bilan sinab ko'rishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlashdan oldin uning qandayligini bilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get a handle on the new software, but now I'm comfortable using it.
cards.exUz: Yangi dasturni o'zlashtirishga biroz vaqt ketdi, lekin hozir undan foydalanish qulay.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish yoki nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: The university has a strong policy on protecting intellectual property.
cards.exUz: Universitetda intellektual mulkni himoya qilish bo'yicha kuchli siyosat mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy mehnat natijasida yaratilgan mulk.

cards.ex: Studying abroad can help you cultivate skills like adaptability and intercultural communication.
cards.exUz: Chet elda o'qish sizga moslashuvchanlik va madaniyatlararo aloqa kabi ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'nikmalarni asta-sekin o'stirish va yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The city has many excellent educational institutions, from primary schools to universities.
cards.exUz: Shaharda boshlang'ich maktablardan tortib universitetlargacha ko'plab ajoyib ta'lim muassasalari mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim berish bilan shug'ullanuvchi tashkilot.

cards.ex: It takes dedication and hard work to master a subject like quantum physics.
cards.exUz: Kvant fizikasi kabi mavzuni mukammal o'zlashtirish uchun fidoyilik va qattiq mehnat talab etiladi.
cards.uzDef: Mavzuni juda yaxshi bilish va tushunish.

cards.ex: Students can benefit from participating in extracurricular activities.
cards.exUz: Talabalar o'quvdan tashqari tadbirlarda ishtirok etishdan foyda olishlari mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan yaxshi natijalar yoki afzalliklarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The research aims to address the knowledge gap in this area.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot ushbu sohadagi bilim bo'shlig'ini bartaraf etishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror mavzu bo'yicha yetarli bilimga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: His writing style is appropriate for academic discourse.
cards.exUz: Uning yozish uslubi akademik nutq uchun mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Ilmiy maqolalar, ma'ruzalar va muhokamalarda ishlatiladigan til.

cards.ex: A good teacher can impart knowledge effectively and inspire students.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi o'qituvchi bilimni samarali ulasha oladi va talabalarni ilhomlantira oladi.
cards.uzDef: Bilimni boshqalarga yetkazish.

cards.ex: The debate required her to think on her feet and respond to unexpected arguments.
cards.exUz: Debat undan tez fikrlashni va kutilmagan dalillarga javob berishni talab qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan vaziyatda tez va samarali fikrlash.

cards.ex: His research laid the groundwork for future studies in the field.
cards.exUz: Uning tadqiqoti sohadagi kelajakdagi tadqiqotlar uchun zamin yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi ishlar uchun asos yaratmoq.

cards.ex: The teacher drilled into the students the importance of grammar.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi talabalarga grammatikaning muhimligini chuqur o'rgatdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror mavzuni chuqur o'rganish va tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The library provides a wealth of educational resources for students.
cards.exUz: Kutubxona talabalar uchun ko'plab ta'lim resurslarini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim olish uchun foydalaniladigan materiallar.

cards.ex: Kids at that age absorb language like a sponge.
cards.exUz: U yoshdagi bolalar tilni g'ubka kabi shimiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni juda tez va oson o'zlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: The essay requires a critical analysis of the poem's themes.
cards.exUz: Insho she'r mavzularini tanqidiy tahlil qilishni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni baholash va tanqid qilish jarayoni.

cards.ex: She dedicated her life to academic pursuits.
cards.exUz: U hayotini akademik izlanishlarga bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim olishga qaratilgan faoliyat.
